scientific_integrity: The quantified theorem is proved analytically; exact finite consistency checks are supplementary. Independent external audit and validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The sharp peak-location factor assumes nonnegative unimodal path data vanishing at both endpoints; the unrestricted finite-path variation conjecture and more oscillatory inputs remain open. Same-source comparison cannot certify publication priority.
title: Sharp peak-location variation bounds for unimodal data on finite paths
